name: manim
description: Animation engine for explanatory math videos
one_liner: The animation software behind the famous 3Blue1Brown math videos — lets you script precise, professional-looking explainer animations with code.
buyer: A STEM YouTuber or online-course creator who wants their explainer videos to look as polished as 3Blue1Brown's, without hiring a motion designer.
business_use_cases: A YouTuber builds a math or physics explainer channel and monetizes with ads and sponsorships, using manim for all the visuals.
An online course platform (Udemy, Coursera) creator uses it to produce higher-quality animated lessons that stand out from slide decks.
A university professor animates lecture concepts for a flipped-classroom video series.

money_ideas.idea: Run a paid 'learn manim' course teaching aspiring edu-YouTubers to make animations like 3Blue1Brown.
Offer an animation-for-hire studio for course creators who want the look but don't want to learn to code it themselves.

steal_this: Take one popular but poorly-explained math concept, make a single polished manim explainer video, and use it as a portfolio piece to land freelance animation gigs from course creators.
